name: Fractarium
summary:
Fractarium turns the room around you into a gallery of objects that cannot exist.

Seventy-seven exhibits in eleven collections: escape-time fractals, recursive solids, Mandelbox realms, organic hybrids, kaleidoscopic landscapes, bulb-box universes, minimal surfaces, algebraic surfaces, knots and one-sided surfaces, strange attractors, and higher dimensions.
